## Definition of done

- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`npm test`)
- [ ] Types pass (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Docs updated (component `README.md`, `docs/`, or `ROADMAP.md`)
- [ ] Accessibility: keyboard path + screen-reader labels verified; axe clean
- [ ] Performance: no regression against `tests/benchmarks` budgets
- [ ] Tokens only — no hard-coded colors, spacing, radii, or durations
- [ ] License headers present; DCO sign-off (`Signed-off-by:`)
